environment.description: AWS Lambda function behind API Gateway (REST API) with Lambda proxy integration. CORS is configured with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true. The API Gateway has no custom authorizer beyond the session cookie. The Lambda runs in a default VPC with full internet egress. No SameSite cookie attribute is set on the session cookie (defaults to None in older browsers). API Gateway endpoint: https://abc123.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/prod/profile/update
